name: Orthopaedic & joint care (category guide)
summary: Shoulder / knee / spine — physio-first honesty, MRI and injection upsells, and panel surgeon rules before you prepay surgery packages.
body: Orthopaedics handles fractures, sports injuries, and degenerative joints. Many forum ‘need MRI tomorrow’ arcs still start better with GP + AHPC physio unless there is trauma, locking, or progressive neurological deficit. Private ortho clinics sell speed; foreigners pay full public fees too, so price consult + imaging + injection separately. Surgery packages need written inclusions (implants, ICU, physio sessions) and insurer panel / LOA rules — non-panel surgeons can shred post-op outpatient coverage windows. Distinct from podiatry and from gym/PT hard-sells. Category guide, not a ranked surgeon list.
